china_race_dynamics.text: China understands if we can get two steps ahead of America on artificial intelligence, it is an endgame for them. [...] They are trying to get ahead of us in DeepSeek and AI. They are trying to get ahead of us in quantum computers. They are trying to get ahead of us in robotics.
china_race_dynamics.context: Senate floor speech by Senator Cory Booker responding to Senator Murphy during a debate on Trump administration policies and US-China competitiveness.

deepseek.reason: The speaker frames China as trying to get ahead of the United States in AI and other technologies, endorsing a competition framing.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The race framing is clear, though the speaker does not use the exact phrase 'policy priority.'
